import json, pathlib, time
p=pathlib.Path('/proc/stat')
def snap():
    parts=p.read_text().splitlines()[0].split()[1:]
    vals=[int(x) for x in parts]
    idle=vals[3]+(vals[4] if len(vals)>4 else 0)
    return sum(vals), idle
if not p.exists():
    print(json.dumps({'available': False, 'reason': 'proc_stat_missing'}, ensure_ascii=False))
else:
    t1,i1=snap(); time.sleep(0.1); t2,i2=snap(); total=max(1,t2-t1); idle=max(0,i2-i1); used=max(0.0,min(100.0,(1.0-idle/total)*100.0)); print(json.dumps({'available': True, 'used_percent': round(used, 3), 'sample_seconds': 0.1}, ensure_ascii=False))
